messages:
Sam (Eng Manager): Hey People Ops — need quick help. We converted a contractor (EU) to full-time mid-cycle and plan a title bump + comp alignment. What's the process for a midcycle hire->FT comp change, effective date options, and backpay? Do we treat this as a promotion packet or a new hire comp change?
Priya (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Quick answers: it’s a comp-change workflow (not a promotion packet) for conversions, but we still need evidence + manager approval. Key decisions: effective date (start-of-FT vs request date), payroll cutoff for backpay, and benefits eligibility start.
Sam (Eng Manager): If we make effective date = first day FT (last Monday), can we do backpay to cover the contractor period?
Priya (People Ops): Short: generally no. Contractor earnings are separate (vendor/contractor invoicing). We can only backdate salary to the FT start date for payroll purposes, but we can’t retroactively convert contractor invoices to salary. So payroll backpay covers salary owed from FT start to first payroll run only if paperwork + approvals hit payroll cutoff.
Sam (Eng Manager): Got it. What’s the cutoff? payroll schedule is confusing for EMEA.
Luis (Payroll): For EU runs, cutoff is 3 business days before run date for changes that affect current cycle. If approvals land after cutoff we push to next cycle; we can do a manual off-cycle but it needs Finance ok + tax docs.
Anika (Finance): Manual off-cycle is allowed for exceptional cases (e.g., missed contractor conversion) but we need a short justification and cost center confirmation. Fees apply for off-cycle in some regions.
Priya (People Ops): Steps I need from you: 1) confirm effective_date string, 2) attach conversion evidence (signed offer, contractor-to-FT acceptance), 3) salaried comp and level mapping, 4) manager approval in the form field, 5) headcount tag (new hire vs conversion) — pick "conversion".
Sam (Eng Manager): Effective date = 2026-03-16. Offer accepted screenshot attached. Level mapping: IC3 -> Mgr-1 (we’re promoting into a manager role). Salary = €78,000.
Priya (People Ops): Since it's a role change (IC -> manager) mid-cycle we also need a short 1-paragraph justification for leveling (scope change, direct reports, hires) for the leveling committee. Put that in the same form. This will count as a level change rather than a simple comp adjustment.
Sam (Eng Manager): Ok will add justification. For equity: should I put grant request now or wait until next cadence?
Anika (Finance): Equity grants for conversions follow the standard grant cycle unless it's an approved exception. You can request a pro-rated grant on conversion—submit grant request with start date and justification. For EMEA there’s additional paperwork (tax withholding), so give us heads-up.
Priya (People Ops): Also FYI benefits enrollment: FT benefits become active at beginning of next month after start date by default unless you opt for immediate start in the offer. Check the offer language—if they asked immediate benefits we need benefits ops to process.
Sam (Eng Manager): The offer said benefits start on first of next month. Fine.
Luis (Payroll): One more: for EU contractor->FT we need to confirm worker type change in the HRIS (do not reuse contractor profile); create a new employee record so tax IDs are clean. That also affects the payroll feed.
Priya (People Ops): I'll create the comp-change ticket now. Sam, flag this message thread in the form so reviewers see the convo. If approvals and all docs land before cutoff (three business days before the EU pay run), payroll will include FT pay from 2026-03-16 in the next run. If not, we'll schedule either an off-cycle or next regular run.
Sam (Eng Manager): Thanks — tagging @PeopleOpsBot to confirm form URL?
PeopleOpsBot: Form for comp changes/conversions: https://redwood.company/hr/comp-change — please attach "conversion" checkbox + manager justification.
Sam (Eng Manager): Uploaded docs and justification. Submitted for manager approval.
Priya (People Ops): I see submission. Routing to leveling committee for level change review. ETA 2 business days for committee + 1 day for payroll if approved.
Anika (Finance): If committee approves and payroll misses cutoff, ping me and I’ll evaluate off-cycle cost/approval.
Sam (Eng Manager): Appreciate it. One last thing — contractor was on vendor rate paid to their company, do I need to attach vendor termination docs?
Priya (People Ops): Yes please. Attach vendor end date and final invoice confirmation to the ticket. We need to keep records for audits.
Sam (Eng Manager): Uploaded final invoice and vendor close form.
Priya (People Ops): Great. I’ll follow up once committee signs off. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
Luis (Payroll): Noted — will prepare payroll feed if approved.
Priya (People Ops): Closing note: for future conversions, if you want retro pay to cover gap between contractor earnings and FT salary, discuss with Finance pre-approval — it’s rare and treated as discretionary bonus subject to tax.
Sam (Eng Manager): Understood. Thanks everyone.
